rationale: The fixed-cutoff packet code already coalesced repeated target paths before capture, then reported the oversized generated path once while keeping the authored target in the reviewer packet. This scenario had no named RED test at the cutoff. A new, focused public-command test was run against unmodified cutoff source and passed; that replay corroborates historical implementation, not an invented original RED. Its historical RED, GREEN, and REFACTOR rows remain unchecked. The cutoff review_targets field still repeated the generated path, but that field is outside this scenario’s stated outcomes.

scenarios.heading: A repeated generated target has one ordered exclusion
scenarios.testFullName: generated review repetition reports one ordered exclusion when a generated target is repeated
